Add as Preferred Source

A newly expanded Utah Supreme Court heard legal challenges to the legislature’s creation of a special court to hear lawsuits against laws the legislature passes.

On Monday, the justices heard arguments for nearly six hours in Planned Parenthood’s lawsuit challenging Utah’s near-total abortion ban; the League of Women Voters of Utah and Mormon Women for Ethical Government’s lawsuit over independent redistricting; and litigation brought by a group of teens challenging Utah’s fossil fuel polices that they allege harm their health and contribute to climate change.

But the justices aren’t really getting to the merits of the case
